general_enablePromptCompletion.label: Enable Prompt Completion
general_enablePromptCompletion.description: Enable AI-powered prompt completion suggestions while typing.

general_debugKeystrokeLogging.label: Debug Keystroke Logging
general_debugKeystrokeLogging.description: Enable debug logging of keystrokes to the console.

output_format.label: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the CLI output. Can be `text` or `json`.

ui_userMessageColor.label: User Message Color
ui_userMessageColor.description: Override the user message color in chat history. Accepts hex or named ANSI colors (e.g., "#B27CFF" or "magenta").

ui_showStatusInTitle.label: Show Thoughts in Title
ui_showStatusInTitle.description: Show Gemini CLI model thoughts in the terminal window title during the working phase

ui_dynamicWindowTitle.label: Dynamic Window Title
ui_dynamicWindowTitle.description: Update the terminal window title with current status icons (Ready: ◇, Action Required: ✋, Working: ✦)

ui_showHomeDirectoryWarning.label: Show Home Directory Warning
ui_showHomeDirectoryWarning.description: Show a warning when running Gemini CLI in the home directory.

ui_hideTips.label: Hide Tips
ui_hideTips.description: Hide helpful tips in the UI

ui_hideContextSummary.label: Hide Context Summary
ui_hideContextSummary.description: Hide the context summary (GEMINI.md, MCP servers) above the input.

ui_footer_hideCWD.label: Hide CWD
ui_footer_hideCWD.description: Hide the current working directory path in the footer.

ui_footer_hideSandboxStatus.label: Hide Sandbox Status
ui_footer_hideSandboxStatus.description: Hide the sandbox status indicator in the footer.

ui_footer_hideModelInfo.label: Hide Model Info
ui_footer_hideModelInfo.description: Hide the model name and context usage in the footer.

ui_footer_hideContextPercentage.label: Hide Context Window Percentage
ui_footer_hideContextPercentage.description: Hides the context window remaining percentage.

ui_hideFooter.label: Hide Footer
ui_hideFooter.description: Hide the footer from the UI

ui_showMemoryUsage.label: Show Memory Usage
ui_showMemoryUsage.description: Display memory usage information in the UI

ui_showLineNumbers.label: Show Line Numbers
ui_showLineNumbers.description: Show line numbers in the chat.

ui_showCitations.label: Show Citations
ui_showCitations.description: Show citations for generated text in the chat.

ui_showModelInfoInChat.label: Show Model Info In Chat
ui_showModelInfoInChat.description: Show the model name in the chat for each model turn.

ui_useFullWidth.label: Use Full Width
ui_useFullWidth.description: Use the entire width of the terminal for output.

ui_useAlternateBuffer.label: Use Alternate Screen Buffer
ui_useAlternateBuffer.description: Use an alternate screen buffer for the UI, preserving shell history.

ui_incrementalRendering.label: Incremental Rendering
ui_incrementalRendering.description: Enable incremental rendering for the UI. This option will reduce flickering but may cause rendering artifacts. Only supported when useAlternateBuffer is enabled.

ui_accessibility_screenReader.label: Screen Reader Mode
ui_accessibility_screenReader.description: Render output in plain-text to be more screen reader accessible

model_maxSessionTurns.label: Max Session Turns
model_maxSessionTurns.description: Maximum number of user/model/tool turns to keep in a session. -1 means unlimited.

model_compressionThreshold.label: Compression Threshold
model_compressionThreshold.description: The fraction of context usage at which to trigger context compression (e.g. 0.2, 0.3).

context_discoveryMaxDirs.label: Memory Discovery Max Dirs
context_discoveryMaxDirs.description: Maximum number of directories to search for memory.

context_loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories.label: Load Memory From Include Directories
context_loadMemoryFromIncludeDirectories.description: Controls how /memory refresh loads GEMINI.md files. When true, include directories are scanned; when false, only the current directory is used.

context_fileFiltering_enableRecursiveFil.label: Enable Recursive File Search
context_fileFiltering_enableRecursiveFil.description: Enable recursive file search functionality when completing @ references in the prompt.

context_fileFiltering_enableFuzzySearch.label: Enable Fuzzy Search
context_fileFiltering_enableFuzzySearch.description: Enable fuzzy search when searching for files.

tools_shell_enableInteractiveShell.label: Enable Interactive Shell
tools_shell_enableInteractiveShell.description: Use node-pty for an interactive shell experience. Fallback to child_process still applies.

tools_autoAccept.label: Auto Accept
tools_autoAccept.description: Automatically accept and execute tool calls that are considered safe (e.g., read-only operations).

tools_useRipgrep.label: Use Ripgrep
tools_useRipgrep.description: Use ripgrep for file content search instead of the fallback implementation. Provides faster search performance.

tools_enableToolOutputTruncation.label: Enable Tool Output Truncation
tools_enableToolOutputTruncation.description: Enable truncation of large tool outputs.

tools_truncateToolOutputThreshold.label: Tool Output Truncation Threshold
tools_truncateToolOutputThreshold.description: Truncate tool output if it is larger than this many characters. Set to -1 to disable.

tools_truncateToolOutputLines.label: Tool Output Truncation Lines
tools_truncateToolOutputLines.description: The number of lines to keep when truncating tool output.

tools_disableLLMCorrection.label: Disable LLM Correction
tools_disableLLMCorrection.description: Disable LLM-based error correction for edit tools. When enabled, tools will fail immediately if exact string matches are not found, instead of attempting to self-correct.

security_disableYoloMode.label: Disable YOLO Mode
security_disableYoloMode.description: Disable YOLO mode, even if enabled by a flag.

security_enablePermanentToolApproval.label: Allow Permanent Tool Approval
security_enablePermanentToolApproval.description: Enable the "Allow for all future sessions" option in tool confirmation dialogs.

security_blockGitExtensions.label: Blocks extensions from Git
security_blockGitExtensions.description: Blocks installing and loading extensions from Git.

security_folderTrust_enabled.label: Folder Trust
security_folderTrust_enabled.description: Setting to track whether Folder trust is enabled.

security_environmentVariableRedaction_en.label: Enable Environment Variable Redaction
security_environmentVariableRedaction_en.description: Enable redaction of environment variables that may contain secrets.

experimental_codebaseInvestigatorSetting.label: Codebase Investigator Max Num Turns
experimental_codebaseInvestigatorSetting.description: Maximum number of turns for the Codebase Investigator agent.

experimental_useOSC52Paste.label: Use OSC 52 Paste
experimental_useOSC52Paste.description: Use OSC 52 sequence for pasting instead of clipboardy (useful for remote sessions).

experimental_plan.label: Plan
experimental_plan.description: Enable planning features (Plan Mode and tools).

hooksConfig_notifications.label: Hook Notifications
hooksConfig_notifications.description: Show visual indicators when hooks are executing.
